title: Tip Pooling Calculator
description: Split pooled tips among staff by hours worked or role weights.
howto: Enter the total tips collected for the shift.
Choose a split method: hours worked, or hours multiplied by role weight.
Add each staff member with their hours (and weight if using weights).
Read each person's share. Leftover pennies go to the largest remainders.

faqs.a: Each share is rounded down to the cent, then leftover pennies are given one by one to the people with the largest fractional remainders, so the payouts always add up to the exact total.
A multiplier for different roles, e.g. servers 1.0, bussers 0.7. A person's points equal hours worked times their role weight.
Your staff list is saved only in your browser's localStorage so it is there next time. Nothing is sent to any server.
